evidence.observation: Pressure steady at ~2.91-2.96 Torr throughout the ramp at 100 sccm Ar
Pressure rose steadily from 2.98 to 3.25 Torr over the growth stage, about 0.07 Torr per 120 s
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the flow did not cause the pressure rise
Temperature holding at 750 °C with normal heater power, so the thermal side looks fine

args.missing_evidence: No oxygen sensor on the exhaust, so I can't separate air getting in through a leak (seal_leak) from a restricted exhaust or pump line (exhaust_blockage). A leak-up/rate-of-rise test with the gas inlet closed, or a check of the exhaust valve and pump conductance, would tell them apart. There's also no reference data for normal runs to compare against.
